behaviors.behavior: MEMORY.md renders as a managed Relia artifact with schema/version metadata and lifecycle summary counts.
Memory page receipt lines show clickable PR provenance plus provenance outcome and experience ID when the rule artifact carries them.
Candidate, stale, contradicted, and retired rules remain visibly separated from active strong memory and render as not served.
relia memory JSON output exposes lifecycle counts through rules_by_status while preserving existing count fields and artifact refs.
User-facing docs describe the updated memory page output and its rule-YAML source of truth.
